svg.text: Signing in once: the user, the connector and Microsoft Entra ID
Happens when a connection is created; no client secret is involved · Last updated 2026-11-09
Redirect to sign in as the agent's app, scope Tools.Read
client_id = agent app, redirect = connector callback
Sign in (password, MFA); no consent prompt
the app is pre-authorised for Tools.Read
Authorization code, returned to the callback URL
Ask for a token for the identity
Redeem the code, proving who it is with the assertion
in place of a client secret
Access token: aud = API, azp = agent app, scp = Tools.Read, oid = user
No federated credential, no token: Entra ID answers AADSTS70025. Tokens are kept on the connection and refreshed.
